第一次使用，按这 4 步：\r\n\r\n1. 在“总览”确认当前权限档位和电脑:
First-time setup in four steps:

1. On Overview, confirm the current authority tier and computer-control status.
2. Open Permissions and choose 02 / 03 / 04 to view a rule layer. Selecting a layer only changes the view; it does not grant authority.
3. For High privilege inheritance launch, choose 04, switch to "Work authorization", then click "Enable work authorization".
4. When the blue "Pending save" text appears, click "Save permissions and preferences" at the bottom right. Changes take effect only after saving.

04 work authorization:
- "Work authorization" does not allow arbitrary programs. Every High launch still binds the exact task, program, arguments and directory.
- Deny wins. A new install usually enables Codex first; DSH requires a separate local confirmation.
